Dispositions consignées à ce jour

Dispositions candidates, localisateurs et état de revue
DispositionLocalisateur consignéInterprétation consignéeÉvaluation d'effetÉtat d'encodage
P-01 Definitions and discriminationArticle 1The Law defines disability, the disability card and discrimination, including distinctions that prejudice rights or equal enjoyment of rights.Non évaluéBloqué
P-02 Equality and non-discriminationArticles 2-3The Law aims to secure rights and services and requires equality and non-discrimination across legislation, policies and development programmes.Non évaluéBloqué
P-03 Communication and information rightsArticle 7The State is to secure expression and opinion through Braille, sign language and other communication means, and the right to request, receive and transmit information on an equal footing.Non évaluéBloqué
P-04 Accessible cultural materialsArticle 20(2)The State is to provide literary and cultural materials in available forms, including electronic texts, sign language, Braille, audio and multimedia.Non évaluéBloqué
P-05 Adapted environment and facilitiesArticles 22-23The Law recognises a right to an adapted environment and requires engineering standards for public facilities, applying to the government and private sectors unless exempted.Non évaluéBloqué
